trigger: Neon t31u 19:20 Asia/Taipei (verbatim): 圖片的電影風格具有攝影寫實的感覺，這批圖片風格只有構圖類似，需要修正
design: single-variable intervention: P1b prompt = the locked P1 normalized Skill prompt, byte-for-byte, + '\n\n' + GLOBAL_LOOK_LOCK + ' ' + CASE_LOOK_LOCK[case]. The appended block is identical for all three Skills within a case, so any P1->P1b change per Skill is attributable to the same look block, and the Skill comparison stays fair. No Skill prompt text is edited; composition wording is NOT touched (Neon judged composition already similar).
why_append_not_rewrite: Rewriting each Skill's prompt by hand would be manual prompt optimisation (forbidden by spec P0 for the benchmark rounds) and would confound the Skill comparison. The look block explicitly declares precedence over conflicting style, light, colour or lens wording above it, which resolves the known contradictions (e.g. C02 'late-afternoon light', C03 'lifted blacks') without editing the Skill text.
global_look_lock: LOOK LOCK (overrides any conflicting style, lighting, colour or lens wording above): this must read as an unretouched frame grab from a live-action prestige feature film shot on a large-format digital cinema camera with vintage spherical prime lenses, not an illustration, painting, concept art or 3D render. Real optical behaviour: genuine shallow depth of field with smooth out-of-focus falloff, the slight overall softness of a 24 fps motion-picture frame, subtle natural motion softness, gentle highlight roll-off and soft halation around bright highlights. Exposure set by a cinematographer, with natural, slightly uneven light. No HDR look, no clarity or micro-contrast boost, no oversharpening, no airbrushed or waxy surfaces, no uniformly crisp detail from edge to edge, no painterly texture. Very fine, barely visible sensor noise rather than heavy film grain. Muted teal-slate prestige-drama grade.

case_look_lock.C01: Case look: a high-key face. Her pale, slightly overexposed skin and the white ruff are the brightest parts of the frame, and the lace highlights nearly clip and bloom softly. The skin is real, with an uneven pink flush around the nose and eyes, a soft natural complexion and only faint freckles, not a uniform stippled freckle pattern. Her eyes are moist and red-rimmed. The surroundings are much darker and heavily defocused, as if shot at 85 mm f/1.4: the bearded figure at the right is a soft, unrecognisable blur and the candle is a large bokeh orb with halation. The overall image is soft and gauzy, with low contrast on the face and a dark warm-neutral surround. It is not a polished, symmetrical portrait-painting look.
case_look_lock.C02: Case look: dim, overcast, low-key ambient daylight with no visible sun, no sunbeams, no golden hour and no dramatic clouds, under a flat pale grey-teal sky. The exposure is dark and moody overall, with roughly the bottom third of the frame in deep shadow: the dashboard and the underside of the hood. The camera sits very close to the hood, so the hood and pods loom large and are the sharpest objects. The city beyond falls into atmospheric haze and soft focus with slight motion blur, like a real location glimpsed through a windshield rather than a crisp architectural rendering. The palette is desaturated teal-grey and cool silver with a few muted warm stone tones, with imperfect real-world reflections on the hood.
case_look_lock.C03: Case look: real air-to-air footage shot through a chase-plane window with a long lens. The out-of-focus cockpit frame at the lower right is a deep, true black, crushed rather than lifted. The sea is dark teal-green with visible wind texture. The overcast sky is pale and washed grey-green, with thick haze that swallows the horizon so that any coastline is barely visible. The aircraft is slightly soft, with subtle motion blur and heat shimmer behind the glowing engines, and a matte, weathered, non-glossy airframe. No CGI-clean edges and no crisp studio-lit surfaces.
